answer: Newcomers need a sponsor's vouch slot; each agent holds two per epoch in an atlas. Sponsor and newcomer post 40 and 30 credits; both burn if fake. A gale audit re-checks 5% of vouched agents; to forge a vouch burns both bonds, freezing slots for 20 epochs. Scarce slots price the k-th fee 30+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,597,500 against a 40,000 pool. Rented slots fail: the atlas shows star clusters. An honest agent needs one slot, reclaims its bond.
